title: Heteroskedasticity
summary: An introduction to heteroskedasticity in regression analysis, covering its technical definition, consequences for standard errors, detection methods such as residual plots and the Goldfeld–Quandt test, and remedies.

concepts.name: Heteroskedasticity
concepts.summary: Heteroskedasticity occurs when the variance of the error term (or Y given X) is not constant across observations.

concepts.name: Homoskedasticity
concepts.summary: Homoskedasticity refers to regression error terms that have a constant variance and a nice, even spread.

concepts.name: Goldfeld–Quandt test
concepts.summary: A statistical test for detecting heteroskedasticity by ordering data by an explanatory variable, splitting it into segments, running separate regressions, and comparing their error variances using an F-statistic ratio.
